message:
test(ka-pc): the managed and shell e2e use the shared test-host guard as it is (ka-r3 b8dcc93)

- every child: started suspended, resumed only by e2e_adopt_or_invalid (a verified kill-on-close job, else INVALID),
  its output read by e2e_read_to_end (EOF only on a confirmed end)
- every test host: e2e_injection_off_arg (--input-injection-mode none --host-power-management off); Guard() --
  e2e_wait_injection_off on THIS launch's two whole OFF lines before any client, else e2e_injection_setup_failed;
  an E2eInjectionMonitor while it runs; its End() is the guard's final judgement (e2e_end_job_confirmed, the reader's
  EOF, e2e_final_pipe, Finalize); e2e_injection_final_check_all before the result
- a repository fixture the run owns: a NEW run-<pid>-<tick> folder inside the checked REMOTE60_TEST_TMP (refused if
  it exists); TEMP / TMP of the test (and of every child) inside it -- the shell's WebView profile
  (GetTempPath + GNLinkClient) no longer lands in the user's %TEMP%
- nothing of the guard copied or varied. Not run (the verifier: test SOURCE first)
